text:
I’m passionate, hard-working, and I’d love to help with your Google Trends research and AI image generation workflow.

I have 6 years of experience in Python and machine learning, including semantic search and retrieval-augmented generation work with Python, LangChain, OpenAI API, PostgreSQL, FastAPI, and pgvector. In one project, I built a contract clause search assistant that answered questions over 9,000 contracts and always quoted the clause and page used. It achieved 0.91 faithfulness on a 120-question lawyer-written test set and reduced clause lookup time from 25 minutes to 3 minutes.

I’m also comfortable with NLP, scikit-learn, PyTorch, Hugging Face Transformers, XGBoost, pandas, and working with data-driven keyword research. I can help identify popular search trends across US, Canada, and UK markets and support your workflow reliably.
